integrity: Standalone mathematical proof and reproducible symbolic/finite diagnostic checker; finite checks do not constitute proof. This assessment is same-model only, not independent certification.
scientific_limitations: Local theorem only: b=d and a sufficiently small positive-data forward-invariant wedge; no global basin, physical validation, or away-from-threshold conclusion. Indexed analogues on different systems do not establish literature uniqueness.
title: A logarithmic extinction clock at the herd-response predator invasion threshold
